name: greek-restoration-by-gap-length
label: Chart
claim_label: Model output: scores of three hosted text models and a Kneser-Ney letter model on public edited Greek text (Philodemus, De Musica); no scan, no scroll data, no ink map
alt: Bar chart of gap letter accuracy by number of hidden letters (1, 2, 3, 5, 8) for four arms. The Kneser-Ney letter model is highest at every length: 0.895, 0.671, 0.500, 0.300 and 0.132. DeepSeek-V3-0324 scores 0.447, 0.290, 0.272, 0.137, 0.115; Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 0.447, 0.329, 0.167, 0.190, 0.112; Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 0.342, 0.118, 0.175, 0.121, 0.066.
caption: Gap letter accuracy by gap length, Greek gap restoration on Philodemus, De Musica, 38 gaps per length, one run on 22 October 2026. Model output. No intervals are drawn: score.json has a bootstrap bound for each model's overall difference from the letter model, not per length.

data.credit: Numbers from this repository's frozen score.json; the test text is Philodemus, De Musica, ed. Johannes Kemke, First1KGreek, CC BY-SA 4.0 (no text appears in the chart)

colors: categorical slots 1 to 4 of a palette validated for color-vision deficiency on light and dark surfaces; dark-mode colors through prefers-color-scheme
